name: Enterprise Ownership, Control and Governance
constraints: Ownership Interest combines holder-side positions with qualified relationships while retaining each master.
Control Relation declares basis, scope, direction, evidence and effective period and never substitutes for economic interest or consolidation.
Governance Body persists across member, seat and meeting changes; attendance never proves appointment.
Mandate owns powers, reserved matters and limits and is pinned by every governed decision.
Resolution preserves decision content, procedure evidence and authentic expression as separate masters.
Ownership percentage never grants signing authority and a resolution never mutates holdings directly.
